architectureDecisions: D1 — Suite: at least 8 owned fixtures covering bug fix, feature addition, test-guided refactor and multi-file change. Each task.json = { id, category, prompt, visibleVerifications, hiddenVerifications }. Calibration (EV1) proves for every fixture: base fails hidden, base+solution.patch passes hidden and visible, and hidden/** is absent from the agent worktree.

D2 — Arms per tool: DIRECT_SINGLE = one BB-097 runAgentInvocation; DIRECT_RETRY = up to K invocations with resume and the fixed prompt "Continue until the task is complete." without verification output; EXHARNESS_SUPERVISED = BB-097 runSupervisedTask with maxAttempts K using visibleVerifications only. K = 3, invocation timeoutMs = 600000, permissionProfile WORKSPACE_EDIT, model = explicit value or TOOL_DEFAULT recorded. Direct arms stop early only when the tool exits without changes on two consecutive invocations.

D3 — Registration: createExperimentRegistration (BB-065) with fixed factors { tool, toolVersion from probe, model, permissionProfile, K, timeouts }, arms, suite digest (sha256 over fixture files), repeats R = 3, seed, primary metric HIDDEN_ACCEPTANCE_RATE, decision rule D5 and cost cap maxInvocationsTotal. Written to artifacts/agent-tools/<runId>/registration.json before the first attempt; the runner refuses to start or resume when the recomputed registration digest or the live toolVersion differs.

D4 — Runner: for each tool, task, repeat and arm in a seeded shuffled order: AttemptLedger.beginAttempt; fresh BB-096 worktree at the fixture base; execute the arm while writing BB-098 traces; checkpoint the final worktree as one commit; independent evaluation on a separate detached checkout of that commit with hidden/** copied in, running hiddenVerifications through BB-096 command verifiers; normalizeOutcome (ACCEPTED iff all hidden PASS; NOT_EVALUATED when the tool was unavailable or evaluation errored); normalizeAccounting { durationMs, invocations, tokens nullable }; createEvidenceManifest over trace and log digests; settleAttempt; auditAttempt in a fresh process at the end.

D5 — Reducer: per tool, pairs by (task, repeat). delta = acceptance(SUPERVISED) − acceptance(X) for X in {DIRECT_RETRY, DIRECT_SINGLE}; 10000 seeded paired-bootstrap resamples; 95% percentile interval. SUPERIOR when the lower bound > 0, INFERIOR when the upper bound < 0, else INCONCLUSIVE. Also reported per arm: falseSuccessRate (tool exit 0 or ExHarness ACCEPTED while hidden fails), median duration, invocations and token totals with coverage. NOT_EVALUATED attempts are excluded from rates and reported as counts.

D6 — Calibration: fake CLIs from BB-097 (FIX_FIRST, FIX_AFTER_FEEDBACK, NEVER_FIX, CLAIM_SUCCESS_NO_EDIT) on 4 fixtures with R = 3 must yield: FIX_FIRST INCONCLUSIVE with delta 0; FIX_AFTER_FEEDBACK SUPERIOR against both direct arms; NEVER_FIX INCONCLUSIVE with all rates 0; CLAIM_SUCCESS_NO_EDIT falseSuccessRate 1 for direct arms and 0 for SUPERVISED.

D7 — Live pilot: `exharness-agent eval --tool <t> [--tasks ids] [--repeats R]` probes the tool, writes the registration, enforces maxInvocationsTotal and writes artifacts/agent-tools/<runId>/{registration.json, attempts/**, traces/**, report.json, report.md}. An unavailable or unauthenticated tool yields NOT_EVALUATED attempts with a reason and no verdict.
D8 — Report: report.json/report.md list per tool the verdicts, intervals, rates, costs and coverage, the registration digest and the claim boundary (owned suite only; not universal value).

D9 — Evidence basis: BB-077 is internal DIRECT_CODEACT versus CORE_SYNC only; BB-065 D12 mandates kernel reuse; the executed probe shows all three tools installed with non-interactive and resume modes.
implementationSlices: S1 — Suite [EV1]: author 8 fixtures per D1 and suite.js (load, digest, calibrate). "EV1 ..." tests assert base-fails-hidden, solution-passes-all and hidden/** absence from a prepared worktree for every fixture.

S2 — Arms + registration + runner [EV2]: implement D2-D4 over the BB-065 public API. "EV2 ..." tests with fake CLIs assert one STARTED and one SETTLED ledger event per attempt, refusal on registration digest or toolVersion mismatch, hidden tests never present in the agent worktree, and audit passing in a fresh process.
S3 — Reducer + calibration [EV3]: implement D5-D6. "EV3 ..." tests assert every D6 verdict and identical output for identical seed and input.

S4 — Live pilot + docs [EV4]: implement D7-D8. "EV4 ..." tests run `eval` with a nonexistent tool command and assert NOT_EVALUATED attempts and no verdict, and assert the cost cap stops execution. Write docs/living/system/agent-tools/evaluation.md, update state.md, run test:agent-tools, verify:current-docs and npm test; run a live pilot only when the user has authenticated CLIs and record its artifacts.

negativeVerificationCases: A fixture whose base already passes hidden tests, or whose solution fails them, fails calibration.
hidden/** is never present in the agent worktree at any point of an attempt.
A registration digest or live toolVersion mismatch prevents the runner from starting or resuming.
Arms with different K, timeouts, model or permission profile for the same tool abort the run.
An attempt whose tool is unavailable is NOT_EVALUATED, excluded from rates and never counted as a failure or success.
A tool exit 0 or ExHarness ACCEPTED with failing hidden tests is counted as false success.
The same seed and inputs produce byte-identical report.json.
Exceeding maxInvocationsTotal stops execution and marks remaining attempts NOT_EVALUATED.
Any write to Core, Oracle, agentic-system, packages/benchmark, BB-097/BB-098 modules or docs/blackboard fails scope verification.
